findings.summary: Round 2 at 941ce51 fixes the blocking round-1 defect. chain() now finishes every SQL read before its consistency checks. A play with no stored history returns denied without being quarantined, and SQL read errors become a generic recovery_required without quarantine. Only inconsistencies found in history that exists and was read successfully still quarantine the play. Exact retries of older acknowledged actions now return the original receipt while a newer action is waiting on the journal; they don't clear the outage health state or expose the newer candidate. Both engines now run compare through the service. The controller's real PGlite, HTTP and journal checks passed on the reviewed tree: npm test 47/47 with exit 0, the build with exit 0, and check_application_card with exit 0, including the 44 route cases. The new tests cover start after a resume or commit on an unstarted play, recovery on the same service instance after a failed SQL read, corruption that still fails closed, and Configure/Test outages that return old receipts. The remaining gaps are in the record only.

findings.title: REPORT.md still lacks the final revision and the controller results
findings.problem: The report calls itself a response-only drafting revision. It lists npm test, the build and check_application_card as NOT YET RUN and does not name the final commit 941ce51. The card's completion section asks for actual owner, exact revisions, checks, unresolved issues and downstream IDs. Downstream IDs and limitations are present. Owner and revision are only partly recorded, and the observed results (47/47 tests, build exit 0, checker exit 0) appear only in the controller evidence. The verification exists, so this is a gap in the record, not missing evidence.
findings.fix_check: When accepting the task, the controller or an amended report records the owner, commit 941ce5147b9e5f150e8c4c7f787eefde65e20eea, and the controller check results with their exit statuses. It also states that the draft's 'NOT YET RUN' entries were superseded by those controller runs.

findings.title: Unstarted-play test accepts recovery_required as well as denied
findings.problem: The new unstarted-resume and unstarted-commit test accepts either 'denied' or 'recovery_required'. The implementation and contract say an unstarted play returns denied without quarantine. The looser assertion would not catch a regression that sends this case back to the recovery path. The follow-up assertions that Start and Resume succeed afterwards would still catch quarantine itself.
findings.fix_check: The test asserts code 'denied' exactly for both unstarted resume and unstarted commit.
